transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic, can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I keep holding on to this belief that my clients and managers are secretly monitoring and using my translations in ways they deny, and nothing anyone says can convince me otherwise. I just can't shake the feeling that they are hiding what they are actually doing with my work, and it's why I'm here today.
Have you experienced any other unusual beliefs or perceptions that are not related to your work or the use of your translations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot?

Absolutely not, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, and my mind is perfectly clear. My concern is strictly and specifically about the very real, hidden monitoring of my translation work by my clients and managers. There are no other "unusual" things happening to me.
Can you tell me more about what specifically makes you believe your clients and managers are monitoring your translations, and what evidence you have to support this belief?

It all started after a tense video call where they challenged my word choices; since then, I'm convinced my translations are being fed into a hidden system and dissected line by line. The evidence is right there in the highly specific phrasing of their emails and the suspicious timing of their supposedly "random" QA checks. It is simply too deliberate to be routine quality assurance.

Have you taken any actions or made significant changes in your life or work habits in response to these beliefs about your translations being monitored, such as altering your work routine or avoiding certain tasks?

Yes, I actually turned down a major promotion and have been avoiding certain projects and business trips because of the monitoring, which has also caused some tension with my wife. However, my day-to-day functioning is still completely intact; I am still working full-time, hitting all my deadlines, and managing my responsibilities at home.

Can you estimate how long you've been holding onto this belief about your translations being monitored, and despite the tensions and changes you've made, have you noticed any periods where this belief was less intense or seemed to fade away?

This has been going on for about eleven months now, ever since that tense video call about my translation wording. The belief hasn't faded or lessened at all; it has been completely constant, and I remain absolutely convinced of the monitoring.
Have you ever had any moments, no matter how brief, where you doubted the reality of this monitoring, or has your conviction in the belief remained unwavering since it started?

My conviction has remained completely unwavering, and I have never once doubted it. Even though my wife and colleagues try to reassure me that it's just routine QA, the clues are too consistent to be a coincidence. The specific phrasing in their emails and the odd timing of those "random" checks make it absolutely obvious to me.

You've mentioned that your belief in the monitoring has been constant and unwavering for eleven months. Can you tell me if there have been any fluctuations in the intensity of your belief, or has it remained at the same level of conviction the entire time?

It has remained at the exact same high level of conviction the entire time, without any fluctuations at all. Ever since that tense video call eleven months ago, I have been absolutely certain of the secret monitoring, and nothing anyone has said or done has made me doubt it or lessened its intensity.

Have you experienced any significant distress or impairment in your social, occupational, or other areas of functioning beyond what you've mentioned, such as problems with relationships or daily activities, that you attribute to this belief or any other factors?

No, there hasn't been any other impairment in my life. Aside from refusing that promotion and the tension with my wife over avoiding business trips, I still work full-time, pay our bills, and manage my household responsibilities normally. Everything else in my daily routine is completely unaffected.
Have you ever felt that the monitoring you believe is happening is part of a larger plot or conspiracy involving other aspects of your life beyond just your work translations?

No, this is strictly tied to my translation work, my clients, and my managers, rather than some broader conspiracy involving other areas of my life. However, it does spill over into my personal life because I've had to avoid family travel and business trips due to my fear of this work-related monitoring.
